Pre-cleanup identities remain recorded in governance/BRANCH_RETIREMENT_RECEIPT.json. Post-snapshot unique evidence is retained rather than deleted.

known_automation_check.note: Cleanup conservatively PARKed exact branch names appearing in open issue/comment state.

post_cleanup_verification.bounded_limitation: The original dependency scanner did not index every operational file on every historical branch or unknown external system. The retained-authority reachability proof prevents Git history/code/evidence loss for deleted tips, and a post-hoc check found no concrete default-branch workflow break. Unknown external branch-name consumers outside repository evidence, GitHub open state, and known automations cannot be proven absent without access to those systems.
